title: IN PHOTOS | Fall splendour in Canada
summary: As our days shorten and temperatures drop, chlorophyll in leaves breaks down, revealing the autumnal tones of yellow and orange, while some leaves develop brilliant reds. Check out the fall splendour…

image.caption: An animation gif shows people taking pictures of maple trees in Vancouver, as well as a closeup of the colourful maple leaves on Oct. 6 and fall in full splendour near Aurora, Ont., on Wednesday. (Nav Rahi/CBC, Nav Rahi/CBC, Evan Mitsui/CBC)

blocks.text: Canada

As our days shorten and temperatures drop, chlorophyll in leaves breaks down, revealing the autumnal tones of yellow and orange, while some leaves develop brilliant reds. Check out the fall splendour in Canada.
From the West Coast to the Maritimes, autumn colours abound
Fall colours are seen in the trees near Aurora, Ont., on Wednesday.
(Evan Mitsui/CBC)
Vehicles cross the Alexandra Bridge, front, and Macdonald-Cartier Bridge between Gatineau, Que., and Ottawa, against a backdrop of fall colours, on Tuesday.
(Justin Tang/The Canadian Press)
Aerial drone still of Huntsville, Ont., on Oct. 2.
(Patrick Morrell/CBC)
Fall foliage is seen outside Magog, Que., on Oct. 5.
(Christopher Katsarov/The Canadian Press)
People pose for pictures at Pink Lake in Gatineau Park in Gatineau, Que., on Oct. 12.
(Keito Newman/The Canadian Press)
Aerial drone view of Canmore, Alta., on Sept. 30.
(Cory Herperger/CBC)
The moon setting over Jessie Lake near Bonnyville, Alta., on Sept. 27.
(Kory Siegers/CBC)
Drone aerial still of the waterfront in Thunder Bay, Ont., on Oct. 3.
(Marc Doucette/CBC)
Fall colours at a park in Richmond Hill, Ont., on Oct. 15.
(Aizick Grimman/CBC)
Visitors ride the chairlift at Crabbe Mountain in Central Hainesville during the Fall Festival of Colours, taking in views of New Brunswick’s vibrant autumn foliage over Thanksgiving weekend.
(Ian Curran/CBC)
